name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Unlike many big corporate and impersonal companies who only care about their bottom line, we make sure to focus on creating relationships with our clients and offer educational product pages so our customers know exactly what they are getting for their money and hence experiencing a unique and special shopping experience at the lowest price available on the internet.



Our company was started by a few Spa and bath enthusiasts to provide a fast and friendly shopping experience that would deliver the luxuriously deluxe product and services that you deserve (hence the name Deluxe Saunas) to you at no time. We are passionate about our products and want our clients to be just as passionate as we are.
